name: Intelliminds
author: intelliminds

sections.description:
Intelliminds helps you create AI-generated articles for your WordPress site.

You generate content inside your Intelliminds dashboard, and this plugin provides a secure connection so you can publish articles directly into WordPress.

The plugin is lightweight and does not modify the WordPress editor. Its purpose is to securely link your site to your Intelliminds account and allow publishing when you choose.

Features include:

  • One-click connection from WordPress
  • AI-generated content created inside the Intelliminds platform
  • Publish generated articles directly into WordPress
  • Secure integration using WordPress Application Passwords
  • Lightweight and fast — no editor modifications inside WordPress
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Intelliminds in your WordPress menu
  4. Click Connect to link your site to Intelliminds
  5. Create and manage articles inside your Intelliminds dashboard
sections.faq:
Do I write or generate content inside WordPress?

No. Content creation happens inside your Intelliminds dashboard.
This plugin handles authentication and allows Intelliminds to publish articles into WordPress when you choose.

Do I need an Intelliminds account?

Yes. You will be prompted to connect your WordPress site to your Intelliminds account during setup.

What data does the plugin send to Intelliminds?

During the secure connection process, the plugin sends:
* Your site URL
* A generated WordPress Application Password
* Basic site metadata (e.g., permalink structure)

This is used only to authenticate publishing actions that you initiate.
No post content, comment content, analytics, or visitor data is sent automatically.

Does the plugin track visitors or collect analytics?

No. The plugin does not track users or collect analytics of any kind.

Can I disconnect later?

Yes. You can disconnect from the Intelliminds settings page in WordPress or by revoking the Application Password in your WordPress user profile.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Deactivating the plugin immediately stops all communication with Intelliminds.
During deactivation, the plugin also removes its local credentials and attempts a clean remote disconnect.
You can safely deactivate or delete the plugin at any time.
